changes.comment: add `--stream-url` and `--stream-dataset` options to read block bodies from a JetStream stream of raw blocks, falling back to RPC. The stream is not trusted: a block is taken only when its header hashes to the hash known from RPC, down the parent links from the finalized head, and it passes every `--verify-*` check that is on. A chain whose header hashing is not supported gets all its blocks from RPC. Transactions are tied to the header only by `--verify-tx-root`, which also checks each transaction hash, receipts and logs only by `--with-receipts` with `--verify-receipts-root`, call traces and state diffs can not be tied to it at all, the same as with RPC. Requires Node.js 22.15 or later for its built-in zstd
